title: ParaQAOA: Efficient Parallel Divide-and-Conquer QAOA for Large-Scale Max-Cut Problems Beyond 10,000 Vertices
summary: Quantum Approximate Optimization Algorithm (QAOA) has emerged as a promising solution for combinatorial optimization problems using a hybrid quantum-classical framework. Among combinatorial optimization problems, the Maximum Cut (Max-Cut) problem is particularly important due to its broad applicability in various domains. While QAOA-based Max-Cut solvers have been developed, they primarily favor solution accuracy over execution efficiency, which significantly limits their practicality for large-scale problems.
